links.comparator_used: Large-scale literature databases (unfiltered primary literature) and a narrow single-guideline corpus
links.outcome: LLM-as-a-judge scores for faithfulness, relevance and comprehensiveness on Long COVID clinical questions (LongCOVID-CQ)
links.effect: The guidelines plus high-quality systematic reviews corpus 'consistently outperformed' both the single-guideline and the large-scale literature database configurations. The abstract reports no numeric scores.
links.quote: Our RAG corpus configuration combining clinical guidelines with high-quality systematic reviews consistently outperformed both narrow single-guideline approaches and large-scale literature databases.
